Indian Railways Enhances Safety Measures, Government Informs Parliament

The Indian government informed the Lok Sabha that Indian Railways has implemented several measures to safeguard passengers and property. These steps include the approval of Kavach 4.0 for 660 route kilometers and the completion of 19,700 kilometers of fencing. The announcement details the railway's commitment to improving safety standards.
